chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa wrote to Ali ibn Muhammad عليه السلام:
A woman nursed a young goat from the sheep with her milk until she weaned it.
So he عليه السلام wrote: “It is a disliked act, but there is no harm in it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.مَكْرُوهٌ: disliked in legal ruling, though not forbidden

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a woman breastfeeding a young goat with her own milk in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal query sent to Imam Ali ibn Muhammad عليه السلام regarding a woman nursing a young goat with her own milk until weaning. The Imam عليه السلام ruled that the act is makruh, meaning disliked, yet not prohibited, indicating permissibility without approval.
